recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant Definition-pattern prose or a Definition-pattern claim for SpecimenDefinition unless OO later reopens that modeling decision; future metadata alignment should be handled under more specific canonical/metadata-resource issues.
issue_request: FHIR-22644 was a Published OO change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, originally asking to make SpecimenDefinition conformant to the Definition pattern by adding all properties from that logical model. Later Jira comments clarified that SpecimenDefinition has sufficient metadata and should not claim Definition-pattern conformance because it defines an entity rather than an activity.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in git commit 5e7e903022d40189ae49e9481df0f7d47a233a31, which updated the old SpecimenDefinition spreadsheet and example with Definition-pattern-style metadata. Subsequent source refactoring moved the resource to structuredefinition-SpecimenDefinition.xml, and later canonical metadata work added remaining canonical elements.
additional_context: OO Jira comments and Confluence minutes in June and September 2021 record that no further Definition-pattern work was needed and that the final block vote passed. Current source/fhir.ini keeps SpecimenDefinition active, and SpecimenDefinition specializes MetadataResource, which specializes CanonicalResource. Current workflow prose defines Definition-pattern resources as activities, supporting the decision not to force SpecimenDefinition into that pattern.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because current build-scope source already gives SpecimenDefinition canonical/metadata behavior without a Definition-pattern/interface claim.

related_jiras.note: A related CDS issue mentioned SpecimenDefinition in Definition-pattern context for PlanDefinition definition targets; a separate audit already covers that PlanDefinition target-list decision and cites FHIR-22644 as the specific OO decision not to force SpecimenDefinition into the Definition pattern.

A later source commit added missing canonical elements in SpecimenDefinition and ObservationDefinition, supporting the current canonical/metadata-resource representation rather than a Definition-pattern claim.
